office: Representative, San Jose del Monte City Lone District
role: District Representative · San Jose Del Monte City, Lone District
municipality: City of San Jose del Monte
summary: San Jose del Monte representative with 29 principal-authored bills. Authored 4Ps expansion, a socialized housing loan restructuring program, protection and benefits for media workers, a Labor Code amendment on collective bargaining, technology-facilitated violence against women, a postponement of the October 2026 barangay elections and a national emergency response framework. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Collective-bargaining amendment direction was not reviewed. Postponement bill is a single institutions issue and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored 4Ps expansion (-3), socialized housing loan restructuring (-2) and benefits for media workers (-1); co-authored the national minimum wage (-2).
